s: Debarim happesulim baetrog ubo l"a seipim: etrog hakkamush — kasher. Abal hayyabesh — pasul, sheen zeh hiddur. Veshiur haybeshut, likshettikleh hallecha veeno motzi shum lecha (ki hallecha lapperi kemo haddam labbasar hachay, veneemar "lo hammetim yehalelu ku'"), shekkol zeman shehu lach — motzi lecha o middochaq hassakkin o missechitat happeri, abal leachar sheyyabash — lo yotzi shum lecha. Ella shehabbediqa shello qasha, lepi shei epshar lesochoto o lechotko shello yippasel, abal im niqqab neqeb sheen bo chesron miggup haetrog — kasher im eno mepullash, dehaynu sheen hanneqeb maggia ad chadre hazzera shebbetok haetrog, im ken yakol lebodqo al yede sheyyaabir bo machat im chut veim yesh bo lecha yitraeh bachut, raq sheyyizzaher shello yaggia hammachat ad chadre hazzera, vegam shello yaggia laeber shekkenegdo apillu hu shello keneged chadre hazzera, shello yaaseh neqeb mepullash:
Umikkol maqom, en chayyab kelal lebodqo, ella im ken roin oto shehu kamush. Veetrog shebberak alayv beshana zo — en lebodqo kelal bashshana haacheret, shebbevadday yimmatze yabesh:

Etrog shenniqqab, apillu im hanneqeb hu rachab ella sheen bo chesron miggup haetrog, kegon shettachab sham yated ab veniqqab beinyan shello chasar kelum, im en beorek verochab shel shetach rochab hanneqeb keorek verochab shel shetach matbea hanniqra issar — hare zeh kasher. Veketzad meshaarin? Im hanneqeb hu agol — manniach haissar al pi hanneqeb, veim hanneqeb hu merubba o shehu arok veqatzar — roin oto keillu haya agol, dehaynu shehayu osin agulla min orek verochab shel shetach rochab hanneqeb, veim haya godel shetach haagulla hazzot pachot miggodel shetach haissar — hare zeh kasher. (Veayyen beyoreh dea siman l"d hekan meshaarin shiur haissar bizman hazzeh sheen anu yodeim oto kelal, ayyen sham):

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen hanneqeb mepullash, abal im hanneqeb hu mepullash meeber el eber shekkenegdo, apillu lo higgia hanneqeb lechadre hazzera shebbetok haetrog, kegon shenniqqab boobi haqqelippa heaba (hammaqqepet et chadre hazzera) mitztzad zeh letzad zeh shekkenegdo shello keneged chadre hazzera, vaapillu en berochab hanneqeb ella mashshehu velo chasar kelum miggup haetrog — hare zeh pasul:

Abal im en hanneqeb mepullash mitztzad zeh latztzad shekkenegdo, apillu niqqab keneged chadre hazzera, upillush orek hanneqeb ober kol chadre hazzera ad samuk liqtzeh haetrog shebbatztzad shekkenegdo, veken im niqqab haetrog mishshene tzedadayv ad tok chadre hazzera, vechadre hazzera atzman nishar mehen qetzat shalem vehashshalem hazzeh mapsiq ben hanneqabim shemmishshene tzedadayv — kol zeh eno niqra neqeb mepullash:

Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim, dekol shehiggia hanneqeb ad chadre hazzera ap al pi shechadre hazzera vetzad hashsheni shel haetrog nisharu shelemim — hare zeh niqra neqeb mepullash, lepi shehaqqelippa heaba hammaqqepet et chadre hazzera enah nechshebet im chadre hazzera ledabar echad, ella hi nechshebet ledabar bipne atzmo leinyan zeh, vekevan shenniqqeba kullah mitztzad echad — hare zeh neqeb mepullash. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir kassebara haacharona. Abal bishat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo etrog acher — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, umuttar lebarek al etrog zeh:
Vekol zeh beneqeb sheen bo chesron miggup haetrog, abal im chaser miggup haetrog apillu mashshehu — hare zeh pasul, ap al pi sheen hanneqeb mepullash veen bo keissar:

Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim, deneqeb sheen bo chesron miggup haetrog — eno posel kelal, vaapillu hu rachab harbeh yoter mikkeissar, vaapillu hu mepullash, velo chillequ chakamim ben mepullash lesheeno mepullash uben keissar lepachot mikkeissar ella beneqeb sheyyesh bo chesron miggup haetrog, sheim yesh berochbo keissar — posel ap al pi sheeno mepullash, veim en berochbo keissar — eno posel ella im ken hu mepullash. Veyesh lismok al sebara zo bishat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo etrog acher, veaz muttar lebarek al etrog zeh:

Vekol zeh beneqeb shennaasa bo leachar shennitlash, abal neqabim hannaasim bo keshehu mechubbar, kemo shergilut hu leheasot bo neqabim al yede qotzim shennopelim alayv keshehu mechubbar — nohagin lehakshiro ap al pi shehen neqabim sheyyesh bahen chesron, lepi shekkol neqeb shebbaa lo beodo gadel bailan — chozer libriuto al yede shenniqram alayv or milmala, kevan shehu adayin holek vegadel beilano, veap al pi sheal gabbe or zeh yesh gumma vechesron begup haetrog — en bekak kelum. Abal im anu roim shello niqram alayv veyesh banneqeb chesron miggup haetrog — hare zeh pasul, ap al pi shehanneqeb naasa bo beodo bailan al yede qotz:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennikkar venireh sheyyesh bo begumma zo chesron miggup besar haetrog, abal im yesh lehistappeq shemma lo nechsar kelum miggup besar haetrog, ella sheal yede dochaq haqqotz nitkavvetz besar haetrog litzdade hanneqeb — yesh lehakshir, dekol sheen barur lanu sheyyesh chesron miggup haetrog — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona shebbearnu dekol sheen hanneqeb mepullash veen bo keissar ap al pi sheyyesh bo chesron eno pasul:

Vaapillu im yesh lehistappeq shemma higgia pillush hanneqeb ad chadre hazzera — yesh lehakshir, shekkol sheeno barur lanu shehiggia hanneqeb ad chadre hazzera — yesh lismok al dibre haomerim sheapillu im higgia hanneqeb lechadre hazzera eno niqra neqeb mepullash, veeno posel ella im ken yesh bo chesron:

Kebar bearnu shechesron miggup haetrog posel et haetrog veal derek shennitbaer, bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehachesron hu mibbachutz, dehaynu shenniqqeba gam haqqelippa hachitzona shel haetrog, dehaynu haqqelippa haddaqqa hammaqqepet et haqqelippa heaba hanniqret besar haetrog, veyesh bah taam chariput kesheokelin otah, abal im en hachesron ella bipnim, kegon shennimmoach kol besar haetrog bipnim, uqelippa hachitzona qayyemet vegam chadre hazzera qayyamin, shemmargish bemishmush hayyad shello nimmochu — dabar zeh nistappeq lechakme haggemara im yesh ledammot etrog lerea sheenah nipselet mechamat chesron shemmibbipnim, kegon shennimmoach kol besarah mibbipnim veoroteha hachitzonim qayyamin vegam simponoteha shemmibbipnim hen qayyamin, shehi keshera kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman l"v. Veyesh poseqin sapeq zeh lehaqel, lepi shehen soberin shekkol pesulin ellu (sheenan mechamat hiddur kemo sheyyitbaer) en pesulan min hattora ella middibre soperim, vekol sepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Veyesh omerim shekkol pesulin ellu hen min hattora kemo sheyyitbaer, ulepikak holekin besapeq zeh lehachamir kekol sapeq shel tora. Veyesh lachosh lassebara haacharona bemaqom sheepshar:

Im nisdaq kullo al pene kol orko, apillu lo nisdaq ella mitztzad echad merosho lesopo, veomeq hassedeq maggia al pene kol orko ad rob obi shel qelippa heaba — hare zeh pasul, ap al pi shello chaser kelum miggup haetrog. Abal im nishtayyer baetrog mashshehu lemala umashshehu lematta, shello nisdaq baomeq ad rob obi haqqelippa heaba, apillu nisdaq mishshene tzedadayv al pene kol orko venishtayyer mikkol tzad mashshehu lemala umashshehu lematta shello nisdaq — kasher:

Veken im nisdaq al pene heqqep rochbo, apillu nisdaq mishshene tzedadayv zeh keneged zeh, venishtayyer mashshehu shalem lemala ben shene hassedaqim shemmishshene hatztzedadin umashshehu shalem lematta ben shene hassedaqim shemmishshene hatztzedadim — hare zeh kasher, ap al pi sheomeq hassedaqim maggia ad rob obi shel qelippa heaba. Vekol pesulim ellu dehaynu niqqab chaser venisdaq — eno mechamat sheeno hiddur, ella lepi sheeno tam veshalem, vehattora omra "uleqachtem", vedareshu chakamim: leqicha tamma ushelema:

Im niqlap mimmennu haqqelippa hachitzona haddaqqa hammaqqepet et qelippa heaba, im niqlap kullo — pasul, shekkevan shekkullo niqlap — holek umitnavneh veeno hiddur, veim nishtayyer mimmennu kol shehu shello niqlap — kasher, sheal yede oto kol shehu hu chozer libriuto. Veyesh omerim sheeno kasher ella im ken nishtayyer mimmennu kesela shello niqlap. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem bemaqom sheepshar:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmaqom hanniqlap hu shaveh bemarito lemareh gaven haetrog, abal im hu meshunneh bemarito mimmareh haetrog — eno kasher, ella im ken hammaqom shenniqlap hu miut haetrog, veeno mepuzzar bishnayim ushelosha meqomot ella kullo omed bemaqom echad, veeno omed bechotmo shel haetrog ella mechotmo ulematta, kemo sheyyitbaer gabbe chazazit, ayyen sham hattaam lekol zeh:

Yesh harbeh etrogim sheal rosh haetrog gadel etz echad shemmiqtzato niknas letok gup haetrog umiqtzato bolet lemala, ubemiqtzat etrogim en etz zeh niknas kelal letok etrog ella kullo bolet lemala merosh haetrog, veniqra "pitma" o "dad", veal etz zeh gadel kemin perach shoshan, veniqra "shoshanta", vehu (nechshab) miggup haetz hanniqra "pitma" o "dad", veyesh harbeh etrogim sheen lahem kelal pitma zo velo shoshanta shealayv vehen kesherin, kevan shekkak hi bitchillat beriyyatam vezehu derek giddulan, venikkarin hen otan, shekkak hen mittechillat beriyyatam, ki yesh lahen bimqom happitma kemo gumma mittechillat beriato. Abal etrog shehaya lo pitma venittela pitmato, apillu lo nittal kol obi happitma ella miqtzat haobi nishar mechubbar laetrog umiqtzat haobi nittal legamre min haetrog, beinyan shennishar mashshehu baetrog megulleh bammaqom shehaya mekusseh boobi miqtzat happitma shennittela — hare zeh pasul, lepi sheppitma zo nechshebet miggup haetrog, vekevan shehi chasera — hare zeh etrog chaser, ap al pi sheyyesh omerim sheen chesron posel ella im ken yesh bo keissar kemo shennitbaer, mikkol maqom kevan shehappitma hi begobah haetrog al rosho vehachesron nikkar bah yoter, lepikak hechemiru bah sheapillu chesron kol shehu shebbah posel, lepi sheiqqar hidduro shel etrog taluy berosho, shehaadam roeh oto bitchillat hashqapato, veim nechsar sham kol shehu — eno hiddur. Abal im lo nittal kelum meobi happitma bemaqom shehi mechubberet laetrog, vaapillu nittela kol happitma velo nishar mimmenna raq gobah mashshehu, beinyan shemmiqtzat rosh haetrog hu mekusseh boobi pitma mashshehu zo shennishtayyer kemo shehaya mekusseh battechilla keshehappitma hayeta shelema — hare zeh kasher, dekevan shemmiqtzat rosh haetrog hu mekusseh kemo shehaya mittechilla — en zeh chesron. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim, daapillu lo nittela raq hashshoshanta haelyona vekol happitma qayyemet — hare zeh pasul, sheeno hiddur, ella im ken hu shalem legamre berosho. Veap al pi sheen halaka kedibrehem, mikkol maqom tob lachosh ledibrehem bemaqom sheepshar, dehaynu sheim yesh lepanayv shene etrogim shavim benoy vehiddur ubeechad mehen nittal hashshoshanta — azay yiqqach oto sheyyesh bo hashshoshanta, abal im oto sheyyesh bo hashshoshanta eno mehuddar umepoar kol kak kemo oto shennittela mimmennu hashshoshanta — yiqqach et hamhuddar veet hampoar yoter ap al pi sheen bo shoshanta, shehaiqqar hu kassebara harishona:

Nittal haoqetz, vehu haetz shehaetrog taluy bo bailan — hare zeh pasul. Vehu shennittal haoqetz meiqqaro velo nishar mimmennu kelum baetrog, sheaz nishar meqomo gumma baetrog, vahare zeh etrog chaser, abal im nishar mimmennu kol shehu baetrog, beinyan shennitmallet kol rochab haggumma, dehaynu shello nittal kelum meobi haoqetz bemaqom shehu memalle et haggumma — hare zeh kasher, shehare gup haetrog eno chaser kelum. Veyesh makshirim apillu nittal kol haoqetz venishar meqomah gumma baetrog shehaoqetz eno nechshab miggup haetrog, leinyan shebbechesrono yippasel haetrog mishshum etrog chaser. Veap al pi sheen halaka kedibrehem, mikkol maqom bishat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo etrog acher — yesh lismok al dibrehem lebarek al etrog zeh, shehare yesh nohagin bishat haddechaq lebarek apillu al happesulin legamre kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trm"t, ayyen sham hattaam:

Olta alayv chazazit (perush "o yallepet" targumo "o chazezan"), vehu kemo ababuot daqqot, veyesh bo mammash shemmeqoman nikkar bemishmush hayyad shehu gaboah min haetrog, im hu bemaqom echad mehaetrog bilbad — eno pasul ella im ken hu rob shel kol haetrog, abal im hu bishne meqomot veyesh ben shene hammeqomot maqom panuy (sheen bo chazazit) lekol happachot keshiur chazazit achat, dehaynu sheyyakol lihyot bemaqom zeh tippat chazazit mashshehu (dehaynu shette ababuot daqqot, sheppachot mikken en niqra chazazit kemo sheyyitbaer), umareh etrog mashshehu kechut hassaara mapsiq ben tippa zo lehachazazit haggadol sheetzlah mitztzad echad, umareh etrog mashshehu kechut hassaara mapsiq ben tzad hashsheni shel tippa zo lachazazit haggadol sheetzlah — hare zeh pasul, apillu im kol hachazazit beyachad eno ella miut haetrog, shekkevan sheyyesh betok hachazazit maqom panuy mareh etrog — hare zeh kimnummar veeno hiddur:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyesh mittechillat chazazit haachat ad sop chazazit hashshenit keshiur rob heqqepo shel haetrog, kegon sheim hen omedin lerochab haetrog dehaynu sebib heqqep obyo umittechillat haachat ad sop shenit yesh rob heqqep obyo, veken im hen omedin leorek haetrog umittechillat haachat ad sop hashshenit yesh rob heqqep orek haetrog, kegon shechazazit achat omed betzad echad shel haetrog vachazazit hashshenit nimshak meat al tzad hashsheni shel haetrog. Abal im kol hachazazit hu betzad echad shel haetrog, ap al pi sheyyesh mittechillat haachat ad sop hashshenit mechetza heqqep orek haetrog, o mechetza heqqep obyo, o apillu mechetza heqqep orko umechetza heqqep obyo, kegon sheyyesh harbeh chazazit qetzat mehen nimshakim leorek haetrog ad chatzi obyo uqetzat mehen nimshakim lerochab haetrog sebib heqqep obyo ad chatzi haheqqep — hare zeh kasher. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim, daapillu en bo ella shette tippot chazazit mashshehu uben shette tippot ellu en maqom panuy shebbo mareh etrog ella kede shiur chazazit achat — hare zeh kimnummar upasul. Veyesh lehachamir kassebara haacharona. Abal bishat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo etrog acher — yesh lismok al sebara harishona. Veim en bo ella chazazit achat gadol shennitpashshet al pene chetzyo shel kol shetach haetrog, dehaynu shekkol maqom happanuy shebbo mareh haetrog hu mechetza al mechetza im hachazazit — pasul. Veken kol dabar happosel berob bekol arbaat hamminim, im hu mechetza al mechetza — pasul, lepi shetztzarik lihyot harob beheksher, veen mechetza hakkasher nechshab kerob ella leinyan mechitztzot shel shabbat veshel sukka uleinyan sekak hassukka, shebbahen neemra halaka lemosheh missinay shehammechetza hu kerob, abal bekol hattora kullah tzarik lihyot harob beheksher. Veyesh choleqim al zeh veomerim, dekol sheen bappasul rob keneged hakkasher — eno yakol lipsol, vahare hu keillu lo haya kan pasul kelal. Veap al pi sheen halaka kedibrehem, mikkol maqom bishat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo minim acherim kesherim — yesh lismok al dibrehem lebarek al minim ellu, shehare yesh nohagin bishat haddechaq lebarek apillu al happesulin legamre kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trm"t, ayyen sham hattaam:

Kol dabar happosel baetrog mishshum sheeno hiddur, kegon yabesh o chazazit o shinnuy mareh haetrog, dehaynu shenniqlap miqtzat haetrog venishtanna marito mimmareh kol haetrog, ap al pi shekkol ellu enan poselin ella im ken yesh bahen kashshiur shennitparesh bahen, abal im haya echad mehen al chotmo dehaynu mimmaqom shemmeshappea mishsham veyored letzad rosho umatchil mishsham lehitqatztzer ulehitchadded kol maqom zeh, im yesh bo echad mikkol ellu haddebarim happoselim mishshum hiddur apillu en bo ella mashshehu — hare zeh pasul, lepi sheiqqar hahiddur shel haetrog taluy bechotmo shehu nireh laenayim yoter mishshear meqomot, ubo adam noten enayv bitchillat hashqapato:

Mikkol maqom, apillu bechotmo en hachazazit posel ella im ken yesh bo shette ababuot, lo pachot (sheppachot mikken — en niqra chazazit). Vehu sheyyihyu nirin laayin kesheochazo beyado, velo sheyyehe tzarik lehasim en iyyuno alehem ad sheyyirem. Veken kol shinnuy mareh eno posel ella im ken nireh lerob bene adam behashqapa rishona:

En hachazazit velo shinnuy mareh poselin ella im ken noledu meatzmut haetrog, abal im mechamat sheoqetzim oto qotzim naasu bo meqomot adummim vaaqummim — kasher. Veken otan chazazit sheqqorin bla"t mv"l — yesh lehakshir, apillu yesh bahen mammashut shemmeqoman nikkar bemishshush hayyad shehen gebohin mehaetrog, lepi shehen nechshabin gam ken mareh etrog, meachar shergilut hu lihyot kak harbeh etrogim — en zeh shinnuy gadol:

Kol maqom shennipsal haetrog mechamat shinnuy mareh o mechamat hachazazit, ben shello hayu ella bemaqom echad bilbad, ben shehayu bekamma meqomot, veqalap kol meqomot happesulin shebbo vechazar marehen mareh kol haetrog, im nizhar leqallepo beinyan shello nechsar kelum miggup haetrog, dehaynu shello qalap raq qelippa hachitzona haddaqqa — hare zeh kasher. Vaapillu lekattechilla muttar lehakshiro al yede ken. Napelu alayv mayim betalush vetapach, veen tzarik lomar im nisrach, sheyyesh lo qetzat reach ra — pasul, sheen zeh hiddur:

Etrog hambushshal — pasul. Veken im haya kabush — pasul, shehakkabush kimbushshal. Veezehu kabush? Kol shennishra meet leet bemayim o bishar mashqim ume perot, vaapillu bidbash sheddarko lehaamid dabar hakkabush betoko — ap al pi ken nipsal haetrog mishshum kabush bimet leet. Veim kebasho bechometz chazaq shehu charip meod, apillu lo shaha betoko ella shaa muetet kede sheyyitten hachometz al haur veyartiach — hare zeh kimbushshal kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"h, ayyen sham hattaam:

Etrog hamnummar — pasul, sheeno hiddur. Ezehu menummar? Sheyyesh bo kamma gevanim kegon shachor velaban sheeno mimmareh haetrog. Vaapillu gaven echad bishne meqomot baetrog — hare zeh kimnummar upasul, ap im en bahem ella miut haetrog. Abal im gaven happasul hu bemaqom echad bilbad — eno posel ella im ken yesh bo rob haetrog o chetzyo, kemo shennitbaer gabbe hachazazit, sheddin shinnuy mareh — kedin chazazit lekol dabar:

Etrog shemmarehu shachor apillu meat — hare zeh pasul. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beetrog haggadel baaratzot shehaetrogim haggedelin sham hen yeruqqim, abal bimqomot shehaetrogim haggedelin sham hen shechorin meat — kesherim, shezzehu derek beriatan vegiddulan beoto maqom, veen zeh shinnuy kelal. Abal etrog hashshachor beyoter keshacharut bene adam hakkushim — apillu haggadel beeretz kush pasul, lepi sheen zeh hiddur kelal:

Heagol kekaddur — pasul, shehare en alayv tzurat etrog kelal. Veken mittaam zeh im giddelo bidpus sheasu lo beodo qatan venatenu betoko keshehu adayin mechubbar lailan vegadal betoko kemiddat haddepus vekitmunato ad shennishtanna mitztzurat haetrog venaasa kemin beriyya acheret — pasul. Abal im naasa keen tzurat haetrog ap al pi sheeno domeh lo mammash, kegon shennaasu bo kemin qerashim, keen galgal shel rechayim veshel mayim — hare zeh kasher:

Hatteyom, dehaynu sheggadelu shenayim debuqim zeh bazeh — kasher, sheen zeh shinnuy kelal, venotel shenehen beyachad keshehen debuqin umebarek. En shiur legodel haetrog lemala, sheapillu hu gadol kol kak ad shennittal al hakkatep — hare zeh kasher. Abal lematta yesh lo shiur, sheim hu pachut mikkebetza — pasul, lepi sherob haetrogim en giddulan pachut mikkebetza, vezeh sheen bo kebetza — hare adayin lo nigmar piryo, vehattora omra "peri etz" — sheyyehe peri gamur. Vaapillu im etrog zeh lo haya gadel yoter ap im lo hayu qotzetzim oto min hailan, mikkol maqom kevan shebbigmar giddulo en bo kebetza — en zeh peri chashub. Abal im yesh bo kebetza — hare hu kasher, ap al pi shehu boser, dehaynu shello nigmar giddulo shehaya gadol yoter im lo hayu qotzetzim oto, mikkol maqom kevan sheyyesh harbeh etrogim sheenan gedelin yoter mimmennu — hare zeh peri chashub, veniqra gemar peri:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmarehu yaroq keen karkom (sheqqorin ga"l), kederek kol haetrogim shennigmar piryam, o apillu sheen kullo yaroq kekarkom shebbemiqtzato hitchil lehoriq kekarkom, shezzehu siman shennigmar piryo vesopo lehoriq kullo betalush kesheyyashhu oto zeman merubbeh. Abal etrogim habbaim lepanenu keshehen adayin yeruqqin keissebe hassadeh (sheqqorin gry"n) — yesh lachosh shemma adayin lo nigmar piryam, ulekak en yeruqqin kekarkom. Umikkol maqom, im hem gedolim harbeh beinyan sheyyadua ubarur lanu shennigmar piryam vesopan lehoriq kekarkom betalush — muttar liqqach otan velatzet bahen yede choba apillu keshehen yeruqqin. Umikkol maqom, kebar nahagu shello lismok al beqiut zo, veen loqechin ella im ken hitchilu lehoriq qetzat keen karkom:

Etrog hammurkab, dehaynu shehirkibu anap meilan acher letok ilan haetrog vegadal mehen min haddomeh leetrog — pasul, shezzeh eno etrog kelal ella hu beriyya bipne atzmah. Vearbaa simanim yesh lehabchin ben haetrog hammurkab millimoni"y laetrog. Haechad, ki hammurkab hu chalaq, ulehaetrog yesh belitot qetannot bekol gupo uqetzat gobah lahen. Hashsheni, hammurkab uqtzo shehu taluy bo bailan hu bolet, veoqetz haetrog shoqea. Hashshelishi, ki tok shel hammurkab dehaynu haggup hu rachab umohal shello rab, vehaqqelippa hattikona dehaynu qelippa heaba shebbaetrog hi enah aba kol kak bemurkab kemo baetrog, shehaqqelippa aba meod vetok shello qatzar veen bo mohal rab.
